what: A physics drum machine inspired by Anukari: six instruments that are masses on springs (drum heads, snare wires, a cymbal plate, a bouncing ball, a resonator, a string), shaking each other, bouncing and drifting off the grid. MASS and CHAOS, per-instrument FM/GRAIN/FILTER, PITCH as time dilation, 16 performance pads and MUTATE knobs (ERODE, MORPH, ENTANGLE, RIPPLE). MIDI clock in. A 90s cyberpunk skin.
author: swtdr34mz
